line: Write a tiny encouraging note and hide it for someone to find.
paragraph: Dale is 86 and lives in Mineral Wells, Texas. He started welding a steel boat in his front yard in 1987. The boat is 62 feet long. He has worked on it for nearly four decades. Strangers began showing up to help him finish. Now his boat is closer to the water than it has ever been.

seed.summary: An 86-year-old man named Dale has spent nearly four decades welding a 62-foot steel boat in his front yard. Now, a wave of kindness is bringing his long-held dream within reach—just when it seemed to be beyond his reach.
